_doc: Backend mirror of the frontend provider kernel (frontend/src/lib/cams/providers/*/meta.ts) — the subset the backend needs. Docker build contexts are per-service, so the two runtimes cannot share a module; scripts/check-provider-parity.mjs asserts they agree (ids, slugs, photo hosts) and also that the Strapi schema enums list exactly these ids. Adding a provider: one entry here, one directory in the frontend, and the id in the two schema.json enums. Everything else in backend/src derives from this file.
